captions.formal: A time-lapse sequence captures heavy traffic flowing along a multi-lane urban road lined with trees displaying bright yellow autumn foliage. Vehicles, including sedans, SUVs, and buses, appear as motion-blurred streaks moving through an intersection marked by white lane lines and overhead traffic signals. On the left, a beige commercial building bears the text "KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING," while a cluster of tall, light-colored residential apartment towers rises in the background against a hazy sky and distant hills. Vertical banners hang from poles along the right side of the street, and sunlight illuminates the canopy of yellow leaves.
captions.sarcastic: The autumn foliage provides a vibrant, golden backdrop for the relentless blur of commuter traffic, proving that even nature's most picturesque season cannot distract from the daily grind.
captions.humorous_tech: This timelapse of rush hour traffic is basically just a physical visualization of a massive merge conflict, where every car is a conflicting commit fighting for the same lane and nobody has the permissions to resolve it.
